Test Scenarios for Numeric and Table Specifications:
Note: These test cases apply to both Numeric and Table specifications.
 
Scenario 1: Default Value
Steps:
Add two specifications (one Numeric and one Table) to the baseline.
Make both mandatory, set a default value, and make them not editable.
Create a CI and add the default values to the specifications.
Run a manual audit.
Expected Result:
The audit should not show any errors because the CI has the correct values.
 
Scenario 2: Available Options
Steps:
Add two specifications (one Numeric and one Table) to the baseline.
Make both mandatory, set them as editable, and add available options.
Create a CI and add values from the available options to both specifications.
Run a manual audit.
Expected Result:
The audit should not show any errors because the CI has valid values from the options.
 
Scenario 3: Missing Specifications
Steps:
Add two specifications (one Numeric and one Table) to the baseline and make them mandatory.
Create a CI that does not include these specifications.
Run a manual audit.
Expected Result:
The audit should show errors: Missing Attributes.
 
Scenario 4: Missing Value or Wrong Value
Steps:
Add two specifications (one Numeric and one Table) to the baseline and make them mandatory.
Create a CI that includes the specifications but:
Does not have a value for one or both, or
Has a value that is not in the available options
Run a manual audit.
Expected Result:
The audit should show an error: Missing Value or Incorrect Value.

test_content:
1	Initial State – Never SLA held Ticket:* Given a ticket is created or is currently active in any state for the MCS (JVN) customer. * When a user attempts to apply an SLA Hold at the Incident level (e.g., by L1) or the Activity level (e.g., by L2 or others). * Then the list of available SLA Hold options shall only include:  SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace  on “top (Incident update features) : in OC And the following options shall not be visible or selectable:  Awaiting customer authorization (SLA Hold)  Missing customer information (SLA Hold) * SLA Hold.
	2	First Application of JVN Contractual Hold:* Given a ticket is active for the MCS (JVN) customer and the SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace option is available. * When a user selects and applies SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace. * Then the system shall record this hold event. * And an email notification shall be sent to the JVN ticket initiator. * And the system shall initiate a 2-hour timer for a subsequent email to the JVN SPOC. * And the SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace option shall become unavailable for selection on this ticket for the remainder of its lifecycle. * And the general SLA Hold option shall become available for selection on this ticket. * And the options Awaiting customer authorization (SLA Hold) and Missing customer information (SLA Hold) shall remain unavailable.
	3	Subsequent SLA Holds:* Given an MCS (JVN) ticket where SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace has already been applied once. * When a user attempts to apply an SLA Hold. * Then the list of available SLA Hold options shall only include: * SLA Hold * (for remainder life of that ticket at any time regardless of how many times it was used on it) And the following options shall not be visible or selectable:  Awaiting customer authorization (SLA Hold)  Missing customer information (SLA Hold) * SLA Hold - Per JVN Contract: Starting after 30 Min Grace
	4	Email Trigger Verification (General SLA Hold):* Given an MCS (JVN) ticket where the general SLA Hold option has been applied. * When the SLA Hold is applied. * Then no email notification shall be sent to any JVN contact (initiator or SPOC).
	5	Strict Customer Exclusivity:* Given a ticket belonging to any customer other than MCS (JVN).  This feature's implementation shall not affect the available SLA Hold options or their associated behaviors in any way for this customer. * And the SLA Hold functionality for non-JVN customers must remain exactly as it was prior to the delivery of this feature.
	6	UAT & ORT:* All defined scenarios must pass User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Operational Readiness Testing (ORT). * MIIPE is not required for this feature.
